notes: This MethodSpec targets the Altman Z score (denoted Z in the paper). The paper also studies Ohlson's O measure, but that is a separate bankruptcy-score specification and is not merged into this executable target. The CRSP price-and-shares market-equity construction is an approved implementation directive; the paper itself cites Compustat items #199 and #25.
